Base Knavery™

by Dom Bosco

Base Knavery is an unofficial, fan-made Foundry VTT system for Knave, first and second editions.
Questing Beast LLC did not make it and has not endorsed it.

System Rules

  • Knave is built in. A new world plays Ben Milton's original Knave as written. Its rules, tables and spells come with the system.
  • Knave 2e relies on your purchased copy of the book. Upload your Knave 2e PDF and build its tables, and you'll be offered a switch to 2e rules. Characters you already have don't change.
  • Mix them. Each rule has its own switch in Game Settings, under Configure Rules.

Buy the books!

Both editions of Knave were written by Ben Milton.

  • Knave: PDF on Itch. Its rules are already in the system. Buying the PDF supports its author.
  • Knave 2e: PDF on DriveThruRPG · PDF on Itch · In print

AI disclosure

  • 🖌️ No AI art. Base Knavery ships with more than 2,900 human-made art assets (portraits, tokens and icons) and will never use AI-generated art.
  • 📜 No AI game text. No spell, item or monster description was written by AI.
  • 🧠 Base Knavery's code is written with the help of an AI coding assistant.

Licensing

Base Knavery is an independent production of Dom Bosco and is not affiliated with Questing Beast LLC.

Knave: CC BY 4.0

The Knave rules, traits, alignment, reaction, starting gear, price list and the 100 level-less spells come from Knave by Ben Milton, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Changes: the rules set out as Foundry automation and settings, the tables as roll tables, the price list as items and shop aisles with one item per weapon, 1e armor as armor points, and "Misfortunes" named Misfortune. A table you build from your Knave 2e book replaces its 1e counterpart.
